topic: comparing the sample run with real output
prompt_markdown: AXIS's draft shows this sample output: `LABEL: rice | SHELF B2`.

options.text: Run the script with the same input and copy the output it really prints.
Change the code so it prints exactly what the README says, because the README is what readers will see first.
Leave it as it is; the difference is only in the capitals, and small differences like that do not matter to a reader.
Remove the sample run so nothing in the README can be wrong, and add it back later once the script is finished.
